The '''Thomquizzar system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] installation known as the [[Thomquizzar Naval Base]].<ref name="FarOrbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thomquizzar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
